entries.04b5271da38da6c9: It develops, manufactures and sells liquid filling film that wraps liquid soup for instant noodles, dressings, sauces, wasabi, soy sauce and the like, as well as general-purpose laminated products for powders and dried goods and for toiletry and cosmetic-related products. entries.bc5156b91149d73a: It develops and manufactures the 'DANGAN' series of liquid filling machines (G3, AⅢ, M), which fill contents into liquid filling film, and sells them together with the film. It also provides the cloud service 'H.U.G.Home', which enables remote monitoring of operating status and visualization of production status, as well as support such as maintenance and training. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,102 million.
